plugins.name: zentrik
plugins.description: Bring your team's product decisions and customer evidence into Claude Code. Ask what your workspace already knows about the work in front of you and get back the initiative behind it, real customer quotes, and the questions still open, each with the record ID to check. Three workflows: brief a piece of work before you build it, set up or repair a product workspace from first-party material, and import customer evidence with approval before any write. Claude reads product context, signals, insights, opportunities, ideas, initiatives, accounts, OKRs, personas, and feature maps from the one Zentrik workspace you choose during OAuth. Access stays bounded by that workspace, your Zentrik role, and the granted OAuth scopes.
